assessment.confidence_basis: entry freshness and cash accounting are exact, but three same-side closes and two unresolved inherited positions cannot establish route expectancy
assessment.highest_value_next_investigation: reconcile the authoritative exits of the inherited SP500 and BRENTOIL lifecycles, then update route-level after-cost and largest-winner-removed attribution

uncertainties_and_failure_modes: open lifecycle PnL is marked and can reverse before an authoritative exit fill
the predecessor sample contains only three closed ETH long lifecycles and cannot establish both-side expectancy
positive aggregate predecessor PnL depends on one largest winner
two stop-slippage observations do not establish a stable execution-cost distribution
the active run has no new entries or closes, so it contains no new realized strategy-performance evidence
the observer successor has one public-L2 HTTP 429 degraded cycle and must not be treated as gap-free
falsifiers: recomputed fill, fee, funding, slippage, or lifecycle PnL differs from either source artifact
either source artifact byte count or SHA-256 does not reproduce
an adopted position is shown to have originated in the active run
a submitted entry is shown to exceed its exact configured age limit
a larger source-compatible both-side sample attributes losses to stable execution degradation or stable strategy failure
the SP500 or BRENTOIL authoritative close materially changes the provisional marked attribution

recommendation.do_nothing_tradeoff: preserves causal comparability but leaves the two existing frozen exit contracts exposed to their already-configured stop and time/profit-lock paths
recommendation.alternative_tradeoff: changing an exit now could reduce future giveback but would be a post-entry intervention unsupported by sufficient source-compatible evidence
